evidenceBoundary: Operation 0x0011's handler, actor resolution, three-word request layout, camera-state mode 6, and dispatch to 0x0c1118e2 are exact executable behavior.
The original sequence-conversion source identifies this data family as Camera/CamAll and MAPINFO identifies the corresponding authored data node as ECAM.
The Hato prelude exactly uses random-float suboperation 0x10 with upper bound 3, truncates the non-negative result, doubles it, and adds 2950, selecting authored camera number 2950, 2952, or 2954.
The exact ECAM binary layout, spline interpolation adapter, camera collision behavior, and transition back to the browser follow camera remain unresolved.
A browser adapter must not replace these authored camera numbers with guessed azimuth, pitch, distance, or actor-relative offsets.
